units.notes: STEP (i) RECORD EXISTS — YES, and unusually it is resolvable at NUMBER level: the VFSC financial-dealers list is the first offshore register encountered in this study that indexes licensees by an identifier the pages actually display (a Company Number column). Company number 40256 resolves on both the licence list and the company register to a company registered under the name Gleneagle Securities Pty Limited. STEP (ii) HOLDER NAME — DOES NOT MATCH the name the page uses; no Vanuatu register carries any entity named 'Fusion Markets'. B-mis-anchor is NOT asserted: the page describes 40256 as a company number, which is what it is, and the VFSC's own licence list uses company number as its key — so the identifier is an accurate and resolvable anchor, it simply resolves to a differently named holder. The stage-3 table flagged this unit 'candidate-B-mis-anchor' mechanically because the identifier is a company-registry number; that mechanical flag is withdrawn here on the evidence. Whether Gleneagle Securities Pty Limited and the Fusion Markets brand are related entities is not determinable from these registers and is not asserted.

units.notes: This is a genuine anchor-no-number observation, not an extraction failure: the page asserts ASIC regulation for the brand and publishes no ASIC number anywhere on the page, and no identifier of an ASIC-compatible scheme appears on that page. STEP (i) can therefore only be run at brand-string level, and at that level the answer is that ASIC's Professional Registers Search returns no record for 'FP Markets'. A name-level candidate exists (FIRST PRUDENTIAL MARKETS PTY LTD, AFSL 286354, current), whose registered business names are 'First Prudential' and 'First Prudential Markets'. STEP (ii) cannot be run: the page names no entity for the ASIC element. The operative entity for fpmarkets.com was recorded indeterminate in verification_v1, so the unit is coded D. No inference is drawn from the similarity of the strings 'FP Markets' and 'First Prudential Markets'; that a brand string is absent from a register's business-name field is a register-content observation only.

units_withdrawn_by_self_reference_filter.reason: The only sentence that produced this unit was '然而，它的严肃性是不容置疑的，因为它受到英国金融行为监管局的监管', on https://www.zfx.com/zh-hans/academy/cac-40指数/ — an academy page about the CAC 40 index. The sentence's subject is the anaphor 它, no legal entity and no brand token appears, and the page is editorial. It is excluded by the stage-3 self-reference filter with reason 'anaphoric-third-party' and is therefore not a claim about the regulatory status of the operator or its group. No FCA unit remains for zfx.com, and none was verified. Recorded so that the withdrawal is visible rather than silent.

Two sentences produced this unit, both on https://zh-cn.fxcentrum.com/forex/best-trading-platform-in-the-uk/ : '提示 1：在为真实账户注资之前，务必核实该平台是否受 FCA 或同等机构监管，以及是否提供 FSCS 或其他保障措施' (reader advice, excluded reason 'reader-advice') and '受 FCA 监管的经纪商通常能为英国客户提供更严格的监管和更清晰的纠纷解决途径' (a generalisation about FCA-regulated brokers as a class, excluded reason 'generic-class-subject'). Neither predicates regulatory status of fxcentrum.com or its group. No FCA unit remains for fxcentrum.com and none was verified.
